gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ by a locally trained architect.
gaps.explanation: 'Was designed by' — passive with the agent in a by-phrase.

gaps.sentence: The experiments ___ (conduct) under strict laboratory conditions last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Last year' fixes past simple passive: were + conducted for the plural subject.

gaps.sentence: I don't like ___ how to run my own department.
gaps.explanation: The speaker receives the telling: passive gerund being + told.

gaps.sentence: The missing manuscripts ___ (find) — the search is officially over.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: have/has been + past participle. The result matters now.

gaps.sentence: This machine ___ (NOT USE) for years before I repaired it.
gaps.hint: negative passive before a past point
gaps.explanation: The disuse continued up to the past repair: past perfect passive hadn't been used.

gaps.sentence: A cheaper version of the vaccine ___ right now.
gaps.explanation: 'Right now' requires present continuous passive: is being + developed.
'She hates' takes a gerund; the passive gerund is 'being watched'.

gaps.sentence: The stage was still wet — the scenery ___ (paint) only hours before.
gaps.explanation: 'Only hours before' points to the past perfect passive: had been + painted.
